# Master Clinical Dentistry Website

This is a React website for Master Clinical Dentistry, specifically showcasing the Master of Clinical Dentistry (MClinDent) program.

## Project Context
- **Target Audience**: Dental professionals seeking postgraduate specialization
- **Focus**: Professional, educational, and trustworthy design
- **Content**: MClinDent program information, specializations, and key highlights
- **Technology Stack**: React, Vite, modern CSS

## Coding Guidelines
- Use functional React components with hooks
- Implement responsive design for all screen sizes
- Follow modern CSS practices with CSS Grid and Flexbox
- Use semantic HTML for accessibility
- Maintain professional color scheme (blues, whites, accent orange)
- Keep code clean, well-commented, and modular

## Design Principles
- Professional and trustworthy appearance suitable for medical/dental field
- Clean, modern layout with excellent readability
- Accessibility-first approach
- Mobile-responsive design
- Fast loading and performance optimized
